description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pentavus, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
The Pentavite enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping the Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.
